title: Purchasing documents
summary: Purchase orders, vendor bills, supplier credit notes and consignment-in documents.

steps.text: The sidebar groups purchasing documents into {po}, {bill}, {scn} and {ci}. Each opens the same document list filtered to that type.

You can also ask the assistant to create a purchase order or bill, receive a purchase order, record a payment or convert one document into another. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.

actions.value: Create a purchase order for 20 mugs
